info.name: Social API 👍👍👍
info.description:
Get JSON results of websites associated with social media URLs.  
  
This comprehensive endpoint maps websites to their associated social media presence across major platforms including Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, and others. Essential for social media intelligence, digital marketing campaigns, and brand relationship mapping. The API delivers domain-to-profile connections enabling users to identify website owners' social media strategies, follower counts, and engagement metrics. Supports bulk lookups and filtering by platform type, follower thresholds, and activity levels. Particularly valuable for influencer identification, competitor social media analysis, lead qualification, and comprehensive digital footprint mapping. Enables businesses to understand social media ecosystem connections and develop targeted outreach strategies.

Updated 2026-11-10 from https://api.builtwith.com/llms-full.txt. Set KEY locally. Requests are examples; sending data requests may consume credits. Optional query parameters are disabled until selected.
